note: Each sourced number below was retrieved tonight through literature search tools (SciSpace and Consensus), and a second independent search was run for it. The Source columns say whether that second search confirmed the value. Water's CO2 factor is an assumption, not a sourced value. We did not open the PDFs by hand. The Flower & Sanjayan factors are for Australian concrete and include transport to the batching plant. Other published factors differ, some by a lot, so treat the CO2 totals as a consistent way to compare mixes, not as exact footprints.

cement.label: Portland cement
cement.co2_source: Flower & Sanjayan (2007), Int. J. Life Cycle Assessment. Confirmed by a second search.
cement.density_source: Specific gravity 3.15, Chandrakar & Singh (2017). Confirmed by a second search.

slag.label: Blast furnace slag
slag.co2_source: Attributed to Flower & Sanjayan (2007) in a table in Kubissa et al. (2019). We saw it only in that secondary table; the link is to the original paper.
slag.density_source: Specific gravity 2.88, Sudharsan et al. (2022). Not confirmed by a second search.

flyash.label: Fly ash
flyash.co2_source: Attributed to Flower & Sanjayan (2007) in a table in Kubissa et al. (2019). We saw it only in secondary tables; the link is to the original paper.
flyash.density_source: Specific gravity 2.2, Sudharsan et al. (2022). Not confirmed by a second search.

water.label: Water
water.co2_source: Assumption: not counted. No sourced factor was found. Flower & Sanjayan describe water's emissions as minimal.

superplasticizer.label: Superplasticizer
superplasticizer.co2_source: Schiefer & Plank (2023), J. Cleaner Production. Confirmed by a second search. CO2 only; the highest of three polymer types (2.40 to 2.98). May overstate: the paper does not say if it is per kg of dry polymer or liquid product, and the 1998 mixes may have used another chemistry.
superplasticizer.density_source: Specific gravity 1.08 for one commercial product, Sudharsan et al. (2022). Not confirmed by a second search.

coarse.label: Coarse aggregate
coarse.co2_source: Flower & Sanjayan (2007), granite/hornfels value (basalt is 0.0357). Confirmed by a second search.
coarse.density_source: Specific gravity 2.68, Sudharsan et al. (2022). A second search confirmed the usual 2.6 to 2.7 range.

fine.label: Fine aggregate (sand)
fine.co2_source: Flower & Sanjayan (2007). Confirmed by a second search.
fine.density_source: Specific gravity 2.65, Sudharsan et al. (2022). Confirmed by a second search.
